label: Every actual root has an own favouring determination
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every actual concrete root r at w has, for some favouring profile phi, the real determination that its own favouring is phi. It is the weakest form of commitment (e) of #2145 (the foundation originates objective finality) that the cross-family argument uses: ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1 at a root (the origin's own favouring prefers the better and depends on end-realization) includes it, but the finality conditions themselves are not part of this statement.
